TikTok permanently suspends ad account for Musk documentary; distributor appeals
stories.line: TikTok permanently suspended the ad account for a four-hour Elon Musk documentary, which its distributor is appealing as political suppression.

stories.title: Meta drops terms language that raised concerns over scraping for AI training
stories.line: Meta removed contract language that appeared to let it use business publishers' website content to train AI, though it says crawling practices are unchanged.
